Guide Discovery V2 behavior and schedule
historical backfill limits, locks, retry/backoff and auto-publish chain

tools.label: Archive Status
tools.notes: Read-only production dashboard over SSH/NAS-native operations.

tools.label: Public Release Healthcheck
tools.notes: Validates the current static public release and safety contracts.

tools.label: Show Missing / Review Queue
tools.notes: Inspection only; ambiguous review_required items must not be forced complete.

tools.label: Guide Discovery V2
tools.schedule: 03:15 daily; max 25 pages / 20 minutes in current LaunchAgent
tools.notes: Resumable historical candidate discovery. Preserve throttle/backoff and existing scheduler.

tools.label: Incremental Sync Now
tools.schedule: 06:00-22:00 every two hours in current LaunchAgent
tools.notes: Normal authenticated incremental archive/update publication workflow.

tools.label: Historical Backfill
tools.schedule: 07:00-21:00 every two hours; max 10 threads / 45 minutes in current LaunchAgent
tools.notes: Successful backfill already performs preview -> publish -> public healthcheck. Temporary acceleration from 2026-09-17 raises only max threads from 5 to 10; keep throttle/retry/backoff unchanged and review after about 24 hours before considering 15. Do not duplicate publication.

tools.label: Publish Public Release
tools.notes: Atomic validated static publication using existing locks and release checks.

tools.label: Rollback Public Release
tools.notes: High-impact recovery action. Require explicit authorization and clear current/previous release display before execution.

tools.label: Authenticate OurSteps
tools.notes: Keep local to the Mac authentication workflow. Never expose Keychain/session material through 8448.
